coordinated_activities.activity: Lying in bed doomscrolling YouTube videos and replying to WhatsApp messages on phone
Sleeping
Washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day (after Member 3 finishes their 07:20-08:00 bathroom slot)
Boiling the kettle, making a pot of tea and eating breakfast at the kitchen counter (Member 3 has finished cooking breakfast; Member 4 is studying in Bedroom 4)
Daily stretching routine on the floor beside the bed
Washing breakfast dishes and wiping down shared kitchen benches
Attending online design studio class on the computer and monitor, taking notes and sketching concepts
Cooking a lunch that fits her medical dietary restriction using the induction cooker, sharing the kitchen with Member 1 who is reheating her own lunch
Eating lunch while listening to a design podcast on phone
Working on freelance creative briefs on the computer, editing files and emailing drafts to clients
Brewing another cup of tea and having a light snack
Continuing coursework and assignment writing on the computer at her desk
Doing a guided stretch and mobility session together with Member 1, then resting with the fan on
Cooking dinner from scratch with ingredients suitable for her dietary restriction, sharing the kitchen with Member 1 and Member 3 who are also cooking
Eating dinner together with Member 1 and Member 3
Washing dishes, wiping benches and taking out kitchen rubbish together with Member 1 and Member 3
Joining a big-group virtual hangout with friends over video call together with Member 3, chatting and sharing screens
Sorting sketchbooks and art supplies at her desk and browsing art supply sales online
Showering, completing her night hygiene routine and running a load of laundry in the washing machine (after Member 4's 21:00-21:30 evening shower, so Member 1 can use the bathroom from 22:45)
Making a final herbal tea and rinsing her mug
In bed half-watching YouTube videos and answering WhatsApp messages while drifting off to sleep
